welcome.title: Welcome to KeeperHub Copilot
welcome.description: A chat for KeeperHub. Ask in plain words for prices, balances, transfers or automations. Copilot picks the KeeperHub action that does it and shows the result as a card.

readsRun.title: Reads run, writes wait
readsRun.description: Anything that only looks, like a price or a balance, runs straight away. Anything that moves value stops as a card with every field filled in. Edit it, dry-run it, then approve or decline. Nothing moves until you click.

orgWallet.title: Your org wallet signs
orgWallet.description: You sign in with your KeeperHub account, not a browser wallet. The wallet KeeperHub keeps for your organisation signs what you approve, inside the daily limit KeeperHub enforces.

money.title: Where your money sits
money.description: The pill in the header is your org wallet on the network you picked. Tap + for its address and a QR code to fund it. Each network's balance is its own and never added to another.

connect.title: Connect to start
connect.description: Signing in opens KeeperHub, then brings you straight back here.

tutorial.connectNote: One sign-in. Every read and every approved write runs through your KeeperHub organisation.

addFunds.title: Fund your org wallet
addFunds.description: Send {symbol} on {network} to your KeeperHub org wallet. It pays the gas for what you approve. Send on this network only.
addFunds.noWallet: This organisation has no wallet yet. KeeperHub creates one for each organisation; check your KeeperHub settings.
addFunds.rereads: Balances re-read when you come back to this tab.

receiptWelcome.title: Your first action landed
receiptWelcome.body: KeeperHub ran it and the chain confirmed it. Its receipt is in Activity, and every one after it lands there too.
